info.title: MSX Milestone Assistant API (Mock)

servers.description: Local mock server (replace with your public tunnel URL when connecting an agent, then run `npm run openapi:json`)

post.summary: Create an opportunity. The TPID is auto-assigned as the next sequential number (e.g. TPID-1001 → TPID-1002) when the request omits it. Side-effect: records an in-app "all users" notification and, when created by an agent (service principal), queues a Pending NotifyTeams ApprovalRequest for human consent. An approved live broadcast enumerates enabled tenant members and sends each member except the sender a 1:1 Teams message.

get.summary: Preview the next auto-assigned sequential TPID for a new opportunity (e.g. TPID-1016). Used by the create form to display the number that will be stamped on save; the server assigns the authoritative value at create time.
Get an opportunity (with milestones, team, notes, recommendations)

delete.summary: Delete an opportunity. Blocked (409) when it still has milestones unless cascade=true is supplied, which removes the opportunity and all related records.

parameters.name: cascade
parameters.description: Delete attached milestones and related records

409.description: Has milestones and cascade not confirmed

get.summary: Full 360° context — opportunity plus milestones, status history, recommendations, approval requests, collaboration notes, deal team members, notifications, agent run logs, and audit logs.

post.summary: Send the "new opportunity" visibility message to every enabled member of the signed-in user's tenant except the sender, using 1:1 Microsoft Teams chats (Path A, human consent). Called from the create-confirm popup after a human agrees. Honors GRAPH_SEND_MODE (simulate vs live); tenant enumeration and delivery are audited via recordAgentAction.

get.summary: Universal "look up ANY field" search across the global business records (opportunities, milestones, status history, recommendations, collaboration notes, deal team members, agent notifications, agent run logs, dashboard snapshots). Matches q case-insensitively as a substring against every scalar field of each record — ids, names, tpid, customer, industry, sales stage, owners (AE/SE), competitor, region, dates, amounts, flags, free text — plus each child row's parent opportunity/milestone. Returns the FULL matching records grouped by entity, each tagged with the field paths that matched (_matchedFields). Read-only, so it is not approval-gated or audited (like the other list/get reads). ApprovalRequest and AgentActionAuditLog are intentionally out of scope here (per-user scoped; use their own endpoints).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The value to search for (matched across every field).

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Optional record type to restrict to; omit to search all.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Optional single field name to match on (e.g. tpid, customerName, aeOwner, competitorName).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional max records returned per entity (default 25).

200.description: Envelope with grouped results (query, entity, field, totalMatches, results[]).

get.summary: Read the acting user's recent Outlook email via Microsoft Graph (on-behalf-of). READ-ONLY and NOT approval-gated: returns only metadata + a short body preview (subject, sender, receivedDateTime, bodyPreview, webLink), never full bodies, and nothing is persisted into the mock tables. Every read is audited (recordAgentAction, ReadOutlook, security event). Works for a signed-in user (web app) OR the hosted agent when it presents a valid user session handle via the x-msx-session header; without a resolvable user the API returns 401.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: How many recent messages to return (default 10).

200.description: Envelope with an array of message metadata/previews.

401.description: No signed-in user or resolvable session handle.

501.description: Microsoft Graph is not configured (AAD_CLIENT_SECRET / consent missing).

get.summary: Read the acting user's recent Teams chats (metadata only — topic, chatType, lastUpdatedDateTime) via Microsoft Graph on-behalf-of. READ-ONLY, not approval-gated, audited (ReadTeams). Same auth as the Outlook read (signed-in user or x-msx-session handle). For the actual message content inside chats, use /api/graph/teams/messages.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: How many recent chats to return (default 10).

200.description: Envelope with an array of chat metadata.

401.description: No signed-in user or resolvable session handle.

get.summary: Read the acting user's recent Teams chats WITH their recent messages — the actual content (sender + short text preview + timestamp) the agent needs to extract information. Lists the top chats, then reads up to perChat recent messages inside each. READ-ONLY, NOT approval-gated, audited (ReadTeams). Only short previews are returned; full message bodies are never persisted. Same auth as the other reads (signed-in user or x-msx-session handle).

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: How many recent chats to scan (default 10).

parameters.name: perChat
parameters.description: How many recent messages to read per chat (default 10).

200.description: Envelope with an array of { id, topic, chatType, lastUpdatedDateTime, messages[] }.

401.description: No signed-in user or resolvable session handle.

post.summary: Create a milestone (connect to an opportunity by name)
post.description: Creating a milestone with milestoneStatus "Lost To Competitor" requires a non-empty competitorName, otherwise the request is rejected with 422.

422.description: A competitor is required to create the milestone as "Lost To Competitor"

get.summary: Get a milestone (with history, recommendations, approvals, notes)

patch.description: Updating milestoneStatus to "Lost To Competitor" triggers an executive-summary email to the seller's manager when `acknowledgeManagerEmail` is true (best-effort; never blocks the update). It also REQUIRES a competitor: pass `competitorName` or the milestone must already have one, otherwise the request is rejected with 422.

422.description: A competitor is required to move the milestone to "Lost To Competitor"

delete.summary: Delete a milestone (status history is also removed)

post.summary: Add a status change (moves the milestone to the new status)
post.description: Changing newStatus to "Lost To Competitor" triggers an executive-summary email to the seller's manager when `acknowledgeManagerEmail` is true (resolved from Microsoft Entra, audited; best-effort, never blocks the status change). It also REQUIRES a competitor: pass `competitorName` (or the milestone must already have one), otherwise the request is rejected with 422.

competitorName.description: Required when newStatus is "Lost To Competitor" and the milestone has no competitor yet. Saved onto the milestone along with the status change.

acknowledgeManagerEmail.description: Human acknowledgement authorising the manager email when newStatus is "Lost To Competitor".

422.description: A competitor is required to move the milestone to "Lost To Competitor"

get.description: Each row includes a sanitized `pendingAction` decoded from the stored deferred action. CreateMilestone actions expose their mock business fields as `milestoneFields` and CreateOpportunity actions expose theirs as `opportunityFields` for human review, and UpdateMilestone exposes `milestoneStatus` for the "Lost To Competitor" warning. Sensitive message bodies and all other raw deferred action payloads are not exposed.

post.summary: Create an approval request. May carry a deferred `action` (CreateMilestone, CreateOpportunity, SendOutlookMail, NotifyTeams, UpdateMilestone, UpdateOpportunity, UpdateDealTeamMember, or DeleteMilestone) that the API executes ONLY when a human approves the request. This is how agent writes/sends are gated.

action.description: Optional deferred action executed on approval. The carried fields depend on `kind`: send actions use to/subject/body/message; NotifyTeams may set audience=tenant for all enabled tenant members; CreateMilestone uses a complete MilestoneInput payload plus competitorBlankConfirmed; CreateOpportunity uses an OpportunityInput payload (opportunityName required); UpdateMilestone uses milestoneId + any MilestoneInput fields; UpdateOpportunity uses opportunityId + any OpportunityInput fields; UpdateDealTeamMember uses dealTeamMemberId + any DealTeamMemberInput fields; DeleteMilestone uses milestoneId.

competitorBlankConfirmed.description: For CreateMilestone, must be true when competitorName is empty, confirming the user explicitly chose to leave Competitor blank. Ignored when milestoneStatus is "Lost To Competitor": that status always requires a non-empty competitorName and the request is rejected with 422 otherwise (for both CreateMilestone and UpdateMilestone, the latter checked against the target milestone's existing competitor at submit and execution time).

audience.description: For NotifyTeams, broadcast to all enabled tenant members except the sender.

patch.summary: Approve. If the request carries a deferred action, it is executed now (send email / notify Teams / create an opportunity / update a milestone, opportunity, or deal team member / delete milestone) and audited. Otherwise it performs the mock milestone writeback from the related recommendation (audited as CreateMilestone). If the action moves a milestone to "Lost To Competitor", an executive-summary email is sent to the reviewer's manager when `acknowledgeManagerEmail` is true.

200.description: Approved (returns approval + created milestone or executed action)

422.description: A competitor is required to move the milestone to "Lost To Competitor"

patch.summary: Reject an approval request (no milestone created; audited)
Mark an approval request as needing changes (audited)

get.summary: List deal team members for an opportunity

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Optional API key. Only enforced when the server has API_KEY set (e.g. when exposed over a public tunnel). Send it in the `x-api-key` request header.

MsxSessionHeader.name: x-msx-session
MsxSessionHeader.description: Opaque user session handle that lets the hosted agent (calling with the service key) run a Microsoft Graph read/send on-behalf-of the signed-in user. The web app injects it into the agent turn; the agent echoes it back on its tool callbacks. Ignored when a real user bearer token is present.

acknowledgeManagerEmail.description: Human acknowledgement (from the Approvals-tab pop-up) authorising the executive-summary email to the reviewer's manager when approving an action that moves a milestone to "Lost To Competitor". Ignored for any other action.

skipBroadcast.description: Set from the "Create without posting" button on a CreateOpportunity approval pop-up. When true, approving creates the opportunity but skips the tenant-wide Teams broadcast entirely (no post, no queued NotifyTeams approval). Ignored for other actions.

acknowledgeManagerEmail.description: Only honored on PATCH /api/milestones/{id}. When the update transitions the milestone INTO "Lost To Competitor", this human acknowledgement authorises an executive-summary email to the seller's manager (resolved from Microsoft Entra, audited). Ignored on create.
